title: PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.01807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. translated_title: PhaseAT：面向医学图像域泛化的傅里叶相位对抗训练
translated_abstract: 深度医学图像模型难以可靠地部署于临床，其主要障碍在于扫描仪、医疗机构与采集协议之间的分布偏移。现有域泛化（DG）方法通常专注于风格或强度多样化，但仍可能使网络依赖特定域的纹理相关性。受傅里叶相位编码语义结构这一证据的启发，我们提出了PhaseAT，一个面向医学域泛化的相位感知对抗训练框架。PhaseAT在傅里叶域中通过迭代更新有界的相位扰动、同时保持幅度谱不变来构造相位扰动的训练视图，从而在外观统计特征一致的条件下对图像的空间组织结构施加考验。扰动仅应用于YCbCr颜色空间中的亮度通道，以避免产生色度伪影。此外，一个简单的相位显著性掩码将更新集中于最具影响力的频率上。模型训练...
tldr: 该论文提出PhaseAT框架，通过在傅里叶域中对相位施加有界对抗扰动（保持幅度谱不变、聚焦于显著性频率），打破网络对域特定纹理的依赖，从而提升医学图像模型在跨扫描仪、机构与采集协议下的域泛化能力。
en_tdlr: PhaseAT is a phase-aware adversarial training framework that perturbs Fourier phase (with amplitude kept unchanged and updates focused via a phase-saliency mask) to break reliance on domain-specific textures, improving medical image domain generalization across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols.
